name: CHEM 1125Q
title: Fundamentals of General Chemistry II
description: Follows CHEM 1124Q. Topics include the properties of aqueous solutions, thermochemistry, properties of gases and chemical equilibria. CA 3LAB.
requirement_description: CHEM 1124Q; open by consent of instructor for one credit to students who have passed CHEM 1127Q, 1137Q, or 1147Q. Not open to students who passed CHEM 1128Q, 1138Q, or 1148Q. Recommended preparation: Familiarity with fundamental algebraic principles.
